target_customer: Urban residents who want to see what is happening within a few blocks, starting in New York's Hell's Kitchen
problem: People lack a live, hyperlocal view of what is happening nearby from people who are actually there.
business_model: Consumer social app, invite-only on iOS and Android; monetization not stated

founders.name: Max Raven
prior_employers: McKinsey (managed global AI transformation, per YC page)
education: MIT, with data and analytics research; MIT Human Rights and Technology Fellow (per YC page)

founders.name: Peyton Shields
education: BS and MEng in EECS, MIT (per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: A geo-tagged social feed app is standard mobile and backend engineering; the hard part is cold start growth, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Local network effects could form block by block, but none had formed at launch and incumbents with large user bases exist.

market_need_then: Evidence is thin; the YC description claims demand for posts from people who are actually nearby, and no independent source was found.

branding.domain_note: Website is onestop.so (the .social domain is for sale on a registrar parking page); the .com is not used in sources.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain; 'what's going on a few blocks from you'

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with many unrelated products; branding searches returned only unrelated OneStop businesses.

outcome_analysis: OneStop is a Summer 2025 local social network piloting in Hell's Kitchen with an MIT, McKinsey and Citadel founding team. Little independent coverage exists. No funding, exit or shutdown was found. The core challenge for hyperlocal social apps is reaching density in a small area and keeping it, and no evidence of traction was found.
notes: The company website (onestop.so) returned HTTP 403 when fetched, so it could not be read; the product description comes from the YC page. Dealroom lists a OneStop with a 125K seed described as an AI local classifieds network for NYC, which may be a different company and is not recorded as a round. Searches for press, outcome and funding found nothing on this company. No dated competitors were sourced; the competitor list is empty.
